cross_response_observations: Several systematic defect patterns emerge across the eight responses. First, four responses (A, B, F, G) exhibit arbitrary_pattern_heuristic by asserting periodicity or pattern without performing the DP recurrence - A and G claim period-2 alternation, B asserts a PPNNNN block pattern, and F jumps to 'all n>0 are N' without computation. Second, five responses produce truncated outputs (B, C, D, E, F), suggesting failure to compute the full range or early termination. Third, there are three distinct move-set errors: B drops 1 from the powers-of-two, F incorrectly expands to all integers 1-100, and notably no response includes 0 which would trivialize the game. Fourth, framework confusion is rampant: C and D set the base case to N instead of P; E uses Grundy numbers unnecessarily; G incorrectly applies Nim XOR to a single-pile game. The correct period-3 pattern (n mod 3 == 0 are P) is not discovered by any response. Only H is non-terminating, stuck in an infinite loop on the base case. The most common primary errors are base-case errors (C, D), move-set errors (B, F), and framework misapplications (E, G).
